Subject: Orchid Bank audit — IRP evidence & SOC 2 readiness

Hi Susan / Orchid compliance team,

Hope you’re well. Per your audit kickoff, we want to get our IRP materials to you as quickly as possible so your reviewers can validate controls ahead of the window next month. To start, please confirm whether you need:

- Full IRP runbook (detailed playbooks + escalation matrix)
- Recent post-incident postmortem (sanitized)
- Sample telemetry extracts (auth, token, and infra events)
- SIG/CAIQ (spreadsheet) answers or a SIG-lite summary

I’ve attached our current IRP PDF (redwood_irp_v2.1.pdf) and a short S3 retention policy excerpt. We can redact customer-specific IDs if required. If you prefer, we can do a short screenwalk and deliver artefacts to your secure bucket.

Next steps we suggest: you tell us the exact deliverables and access method (secure upload vs SFTP vs shared Drive link) and we’ll schedule a 30-min walkthrough.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber

Jonas — thanks for the quick reply and the attachments. A couple of clarifying items from the audit side:

1) Our assessors require a completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet (we can accept SIG-lite for some low-risk items). Could you confirm if you have a current spreadsheet version and whether you prefer we send our template?
2) For telemetry, we need timestamped samples (UTC) for the past 30 days for the auth and token flows, with fields anonymized. A CSV export is fine.
3) For postmortems, sanitized versions that remove customer identifiers are ideal — can you confirm redaction approach?
4) Access method: we have an SFTP drop for evidence ingestion (sftp.orchidbank.com). If you have a secure Drive share, that’s acceptable but please ensure link ACL is restricted to our audit emails.

Can you also confirm if there are any scheduled maintenance windows next week that could complicate evidence pull?

If helpful, I can send over our SIG/CAIQ template (xlsx) and an ingestion checklist.

Best,
Susan Hughes
Director, Compliance & Controls | Orchid Bank
susan.hughes@orchidbank.com
[attachment: sig_questionnaire_request.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

Hi Susan — looping in our IR/controls lead (Laura) so we can respond with specifics. Answers inline and next steps below.

1) SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a SIG spreadsheet (current) and can populate Orchid’s template. I’ve attached the redwood_irp_v2.1.pdf and a short S3 retention snippet. We will map our answers to your xlsx and return a completed worksheet by EOD Thurs (2026-08-06).

2) Telemetry extracts: we can provide anonymized CSVs for auth and token flows (UTC timestamps). Laura — can you confirm retention windows and a sanitized export plan?

3) Postmortems: we redact account/customer identifiers, IP addresses that directly identify customers, and include attacker timeline and root cause. See redaction notes at the top of the attached IRP.

4) Access method: we can upload to your SFTP endpoint. Please provide a temporary ingest path and preferred filename prefix. If you prefer Drive, we’ll use the Drive folder link in the related_links field.

Proposed schedule:
- Wed 2026-08-05, 09:00–09:30 PT — 30-min walkthrough (we’ll demo the IRP and evidence locations)
- Thu 2026-08-06 EOD — deliver completed SIG/CAIQ worksheet + telemetry CSVs

Attachments: redwood_irp_v2.1.pdf (IRP), s3_retention_policy_snippet.txt.

Thanks — we’ll hold the walkthrough slot tentative until you confirm.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety | Redwood Inference
